title: Bring back per-virtual-desktop wallpapers
line: The Image wallpaper can now show a different picture on each virtual desktop.
explanation: Since Plasma 5 a screen has one desktop containment per activity, so its one wallpaper is shown on every virtual desktop and picking an image changes all of them. The full fix proposed in the thread (one containment per virtual desktop in ShellCorona) is a large refactor that nobody has taken on in ten years. This change adds an option to the Image wallpaper, "Use a different wallpaper for each virtual desktop" (shown when there is more than one desktop). When it is on, the wallpaper remembers an image for each virtual desktop of its screen and switches to it when that desktop becomes current, and any change of the image (config dialog, System Settings, plasma-apply-wallpaperimage, drag and drop) applies to the current desktop only.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: allow a different wallpaper for each virtual desktop

Every virtual desktop always showed the same image. A new option
remembers the image of each desktop and shows it again when that desktop
becomes current, so choosing an image only changes that desktop.

BUG: 341143

media.caption: Desktop and Wallpaper dialog on master with 3 virtual desktops: no way to set a wallpaper per desktop.
Master: Altai chosen on desktop 1 (left) also shows on desktop 2 (right).
With the fix the dialog has a "Use a different wallpaper for each virtual desktop" checkbox.
With the option on: desktop 1 Altai, desktop 2 Autumn, desktop 3 Canopée.
Switching between the three desktops: each one keeps its own wallpaper, with the usual crossfade.
